rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to say someone is extremely afraid.

example.english: I was absolutely petrified the first time I rode a roller coaster alone.
example.traditional: 我第一次自己一個人坐過山車，真係好驚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 co5 gwo3 saan1 ce1 zan1 hai6 hou2 geng1

rows.note: Use this when fear has left the person frozen or stunned.

example.english: I was petrified when I heard a strange noise outside my front door.
example.traditional: 聽到屋企門口有怪聲，我即刻嚇到呆咗。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2 jau5 gwaai3 seng1 ngo5 zik1 hak1 haak3 dou3 ngoi4 zo2

rows.note: Use this for something literally transformed into stone, especially in a scientific or fictional context.

example.english: This magic can leave people petrified instantly.
example.traditional: 呢種魔法會令人即刻石化。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 mo1 faat3 wui5 ling6 jan4 zik1 hak1 sek6 faa3
